# Undo Close brings back what closed wherever it was (in liberttyd: --persist).
# A pane closed in one workspace, Undo pressed from another: its workspace
# comes forward and the pane is back in its tab. Where it can't come back
# (its tab gone to another window meanwhile), its program ends then, not
# runs on in liberttyd where no window shows it.
workspace:new:Temp
expect-workspace:=Default [Temp]
key:cmd+d
wait:0.8
type:sleep 31337
key:enter
wait:0.8
action:close_surface
wait:0.6
sheet:Close
wait:0.8
expect-panes:1
expect-shell:pgrep -f 'sleep 3133[7]' >/dev/null && echo STILL-RUNNING ==> STILL-RUNNING
workspace:1
expect-workspace:=[Default] Temp
undo:go
wait:1.0
expect-workspace:=Default [Temp]
expect-panes:2
expect-focus:2
expect-shell:pgrep -f 'sleep 3133[7]' >/dev/null && echo STILL-RUNNING ==> STILL-RUNNING
# Closed again, and its tab moved to a window of its own before Undo.
action:close_surface
wait:0.6
sheet:Close
wait:0.8
expect-panes:1
tab:new
wait:0.5
tab:1
action:move_tab_to_new_window
expect-windows:2
undo:go
wait:1.0
expect-shell:pgrep -f 'sleep 3133[7]' >/dev/null || echo ENDED ==> ENDED
